title: Seasonal Collections Note — Late Charges of the Idle Season at an Electric Service by Rate Schedule Restore
content:
**Note.** Late payment charges that fell on an idle Electric Service by Rate Schedule account during its idle season are held back, in whole or in part, from the restore payment. The charges concerned are the late payment charges dated less than the whole months elapsed since the idle date before the current date.

| Late payment charges of the idle season | Connected | Held back from the restore payment |
|---|---|---|
| One or more | Less than 36 whole months before the current date | Those late payment charges in full |
| One or more | 36 whole months or more before the current date | Half of them, rounded to the cent |
| None | Any | Nothing |

The part held back is taken off the restore payment before that payment is rounded to the cent and held at no less than zero.

### Hypothetical cases (idle date 5 whole months and some days before the current date)

| Late payment charges dated less than 5 whole months before the current date | Connected | Held back |
|---|---|---|
| $3.00 and $4.50 | 30 whole months | $7.50 |
| $3.00 and $4.50 | 90 whole months | $3.75 |
| None | 30 whole months | Nothing |

### Point of reading

- When the idle date is less than one whole month before the current date, the span holds no whole month and no late payment charge is held back.
